verdict: Google profile engagement dropped sharply; no paid campaigns are running.
narrative: This period, your Google Business Profile was the only active channel, generating 90 total actions — 20 calls, 36 direction requests, and 34 website clicks — with zero paid spend on Meta or Google Ads. GBP engagement fell 66.67% over the last 7 days, and the final 3 days of the period recorded zero actions, meaning the drop is still moving in the wrong direction. Separately, calls and web clicks from your profile are not entering your intake pipeline, so contacts that should be becoming opportunities are going untracked — we're working to close that gap now. Instagram organic reach grew 34% week over week, which is the one clear positive signal this period; that momentum is being maintained while the intake and visibility issues are addressed.
